cost_gate.rule: Before any Wave 01 economic outcome is opened, M6 must attach applicable VERIFIED historical cost information or a prospectively frozen CONSERVATIVE_BOUND; otherwise do not open that outcome.

selection_objective: First materially-distinct Discovery wave maximizing mechanism orthogonality and shared-data efficiency without parameter grids.
selection_rationale: Uses the only currently registered reusable V2 DEVELOPMENT market pack to avoid candidate-specific acquisition before wave freeze.
Covers time-series trend, time-series mean reversion, breakout, cross-sectional ranking, and relative-value structure with one prospectively frozen specification each.
No parameter grids, cosmetic duplicates, minor hold variants, allocator rescue, or economic ranking were used to select the wave.
This wave is not the universe and does not exhaust FX, H1, any mechanism family, or any asset class.
Non-FX and other-resolution families remain eligible under HYPOTHESIS_SPACE_V1 and the unchanged 84-identity ceiling.
